stories.title: What both sides have said about a U.S.-Iran deal
stories.description: President Trump took to social media Saturday and said the U.S. and Iran are close to deal on ending the war. But the president didn't offer details and it's not yet clear where Iran stands.

stories.title: What we know about the status of a U.S.-Iran deal
stories.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks to Ariane Tabatabaithe, Public Service Fellow at Lawfare, about where things stand on a potential deal between the U.S. and Iran on ending the war.

stories.title: Trump touts Iran breakthrough but details remain unclear
stories.description: President Trump announced the unfinalized deal on social media after talks with Israel and other allies. Iran did not officially confirm the deal, and state media contradicted parts of it.

stories.title: Severe global food crisis could come within the year, says UN agency
stories.description: Maximo Torero, Chief Economist at The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, warns that the war in Iran is choking the global supply of fertilizer and a food crisis could follow within a year.

stories.title: Video shows Israeli 'double-tap strike' killed medics and a toddler in Lebanon

stories.title: What will Trump do next with Iran?
stories.description: Three months since the start of its conflict with Iran, the Trump administration is oscillating between strike threats and diplomatic overtures. Neither path has yielded a clear resolution.
